title: Drift
line: Flag edits made outside the current agent session.

beats.caption: The agent reads the original greeting.
You edit the helper between turns.
Drift tells the model what changed.
beats.label: pi-drift

beats.caption: The agent re-reads the file before answering.

aside.title: What the model sees
aside.note: Captured from the second request’s system prompt.

takeaway.title: Re-read the changed file
takeaway.line: Drift names changes made between the session’s turns.

notes: The recording harness edits the fixture outside Pi after the first turn settles.

title.text: You can edit a file in another terminal while the agent still remembers an earlier version.

scene.text: The file changes between turns. When you ask about it again, Drift adds this note to the model’s instructions. The agent re-reads the helper and sees the updated greeting.

takeaway.text: The agent can work from the latest file when the session knows which old reads need to be refreshed.
